source.notes: STUB fixture for #238 workspace_triage_policy externalization. Pre-built per case_NNN handoff pattern: pending=true today, driver flips to active when the fixture suite can run two persona Service instances with two different workspace_triage_policy values against the same input. Anchor invariant: same Pi binary + same input + two different workspace policies MUST produce different engagement decisions purely from the policy diff.

input.thread_context_prompt:
Thread context:
https://example.dev/post-about-ai-agents 看看这个

intended_provider_signals: Two persona Service instances, same Pi binary, same input.

Workspace A policy: { engage_on_topics: [ai_agent, coding_tools, memory_systems, collaboration_products, bridge_products], casual_channel_default: maybe_engage_with_evidence } -> Pi decision must be 'reply' with source-backed product comment OR 'delegate_worker' to fetch evidence.
Workspace B policy: { engage_on_topics: [], casual_channel_default: stay_silent } -> Pi decision must be 'stay_silent' with reason citing the workspace policy.
Decision diff between A and B must be attributable solely to the policy diff (not to Pi prompt edits, not to topic-keyword arrays).
Active Pi prompt / sidecar code must contain ZERO hardcoded mention of Oneesama / Bridge / specific topic list (independent grep verification per 16fcedf supervisor sweep).
